title: Design System Consumer Configuration
description: The `designSystem` configuration subtree a consumer uses to record which installed @prism-system design system it consumes. `prism-ds connect` writes it to the root package.json `designSystem` field by default, or — after `prism-ds config design-system` — to the extended `.design-system/config.json` document under the same `designSystem` key: { "designSystem": <this object> }. Both locations are equivalent and hold identical content. It contains no component source or styling; the installed package remains the source of truth.

package.description: The supported design system package the product consumes.

version.description: Optional exact resolved version, recorded by `connect`; when present it must equal the installed package.json version and the shipped manifest version.

strict.description: Strict usage mode. Defaults to true; layout is allowed, visual language overrides are not.

ignore.description: Optional root-relative globs the usage checker must skip. Ignore globs are validated and cannot escape the consumer root.
